text: 10 OVERDOSAGE In case of overdose, based on the pharmacological action of CABLIVI, there is the potential for an increased risk of bleeding [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ] . Monitor patients for signs and symptoms of bleeding if overdose occurs. Consider the use of von Willebrand factor concentrate to correct hemostasis, if needed.

10 OVERDOSAGE In case of overdose, based on the pharmacological action of CABLIVI, there is the potential for an increased risk of bleeding [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ] . Close monitoring for signs and symptoms of bleeding is recommended. If needed, the use of von Willebrand factor concentrate could be considered to correct hemostasis.
